Slovak financial transaction tax

Native ledger sources, reviewed DFT classifications and OZNDFTv26 reporting.

Version19.0.1.0.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresl10n_sk_base, l10n_cssk_submission_base, base_iban

What it is for

Prepare a corporate self-assessment notice from posted journal items and retained actual transaction/payment evidence. This module uses the shared statutory retention and delivery workflow. It does not inherit the dividend notice and does not replace the native accounting ledger.

Common case

  1. Select the month and a posted foreign-account bank credit, its actual date and the evidence for self-assessment grounds c. Review the computed deadline.
  2. Review sources, then Post tax to create the native 538/345 liability once.
  3. Export XML; the retained payload and exact attachment are frozen together.
  4. Record the actual filing and retain its receipt in shared delivery tracking. This records a filing, it does not transmit it or prove authority acceptance.

A changed phone, address or ledger after export warns that a correction may be needed. It does not replace the exported bytes or prevent recording their actual filing. Posting an already filed notice uses its retained filed payload.

Bank sources must credit the default payment account of a bank journal. Petty cash is not a bank transfer. Reversed entries and reversal entries cannot become new payment or tax-credit sources. This module's own provision is not paid tax. An externally posted provision reversal is reused instead of reversed again.

For a bank batch, mark every part as a batch payment, enter each individual amount and unique transaction reference, and review all parts. They must sum to the complete native line. The cap and minimum then apply to each payment; for example ten payments of 5,000 EUR give 200 EUR, not one 40 EUR cap. An incomplete batch is refused. Reuse of the bank amount in another filed month remains barred.

Sources

Use the actual bank credit for a transfer/cash withdrawal. A resident payer's tax base is the whole actual debit, not an expense-deductibility percentage. Review the actual transaction date independently from a later bookkeeping date. For foreign currency retain the amount, currency and official ECB/NBS quote valid for that day. The tax calculation retains the unrounded converted base; the XML displays the base to cents. The accounting rate can legitimately differ.

Recharged costs refer to the actual payable settlement, including an offset, and identify each original third-party transaction separately from its repayment. A single repayment may cover several original transactions. Tax reductions and other corrections have their own posted tax source and reviewed legal allocation evidence. Posting a tax liability is not proof that tax was actually paid.

The operator reviews self-assessment grounds c/d/e, exclusions and tax already collected by a bank; these are not inferred from an IBAN alone. Exempt and bank-collected sources remain evidence and are not taxed twice. Annual card usage uses a stable card reference, never a full card number.

Workflow

An ordinary accountant selects the company/month, preparation and actual/intended filing day and actual submitting person. The statutory deadline is computed; a calendar reference is optional. The existing submission-preparer role gives access to delivery/receipt records. The preparation date cannot follow the filing date. A corrective notice is available through the computed deadline; an additional one follows it and retains the discovery date and previous known tax.

Review sources builds a frozen preview. Post tax creates a native 538/345 entry or 345/538 for a negative result; it does not manufacture a payment/refund. Repeated posting is idempotent. An unfiled provision can be reversed natively. A filed correction posts only the difference from actual provisions/reversals in the chain, not another full liability. Export uses the original pinned XSD. Record filing retains exact XML/source snapshots and opens shared delivery tracking; it does not send the notice or claim authority acceptance.

Reset retains filed evidence and accounting history. Changing a filed payload requires a separate correction. Stored XML can be downloaded without rerunning today's master-data checks. Same-content storage migration remains available.

Current validation boundaries

XML validation verifies the form structure; it does not prove receipt by the authority. Identified original transactions share their EUR 40 cap across partial repayments and earlier effective filed periods. Changing an earlier allocation requires a reviewed amendment of later notices; Check earlier recharges detects this dependency without rewriting their filed XML. Excluded recharges retain their reviewed classification.

The accountant records the company's reviewed share of tax already paid by the original payer, with the receipt and allocation in the source reference. The native ledger source is the company's own share; the module does not infer a legal allocation from a third party's total receipt. The same source cannot be claimed beyond its remaining amount across effective filed periods.

Partial-month dates stay inside the reported month. The published official form requires the first date to precede the last date; a one-day period needs an explicit authority/form resolution and is not silently expanded. A foreign non-IBAN refund uses the company's bank account, SWIFT/BIC and actual branch name/city/country, rather than inferring the branch country from the BIC. A complete company-close reconciliation and future vintage 2027 remain open. The statutory deadline is computed as the end of the next month, moved to the next working day under Tax Code section 27(4). A date typed by an operator does not extend the statutory limit; no general discretionary extension is offered. Late regular notices warn; corrections use the computed deadline.

Scope

Recording a filing after its deadline does not prove that it was actually sent late. When the retained export claims an on-time filing date but is recorded later, Odoo posts a receipt-verification warning with both dates. Retain the actual portal receipt. If a corrective notice was actually filed after the deadline, prepare an additional notice under section 16 of the Tax Code. The warning preserves legitimate retrospective recording and the original XML; it does not certify the entered date or authority acceptance.

A Slovak bank account with only foreign-provider payer grounds also warns: check whether the domestic bank already collected the tax. A legitimate domestic special account remains possible, and the warning changes no amount.

OZNDFTv26 supports periods from January 2026. April–December 2025, their corrections and the 2025 card tax filed in January 2026 need OZNDFTv25 and are outside this module. Announced repeal from 2027 is not treated as enacted law; verify the effective law and form before using a future period.

Primary references are the official form, FS FAQ and the original XSD pinned in data/SCHEMA_VERSION.
